component.name: Visu
component.summary: Interactive algorithm and data structure visualizer

description.p: Visu bridges the gap between pseudocode and the mental model of how algorithms and data structures behave. Write pseudocode in the editor, press Run, and watch arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists and binary search trees animate step by step.

ul.li: Simple pseudocode language with arrays, stacks, queues, lists and BSTs
Step-by-step timeline with play / pause / scrub controls
Minimalist split layout — canvas on the left, editor on the right
Built-in pseudocode reference and example programs

screenshot.caption: Building a directed graph step by step
